# Recorded flight fixtures

Lossless receiver logs from GS1, GS2 and GS3, used only in automated tests.
See [recording notes](../../../docs/RECORDING_FIXTURES.md) for provenance,
timing and quality notes. `manifest.json` hashes refer to the original
**uncompressed** bytes. The test helper checks each log before decoding it.

Manifest `file` and `source_filename` values use generic fixture names; the
uncompressed hashes identify the original user-supplied receiver logs.
